{"code":"
local function resolve(attacker, defender, skill)
  attacker = attacker or {}
  defender = defender or {}
  skill = skill or {}
  local atk = attacker.atk or 0
  local alevel = attacker.level or 0
  local crit_chance = attacker.crit_chance or 0
  local crit_mult = attacker.crit_mult or 150
  local pen_pct = attacker.pen_pct or 0
  local pen_flat = attacker.pen_flat or 0
  local hp = defender.hp or 1
  local shield = defender.shield or 0
  local armor = defender.armor or 0
  local dlevel = defender.level or 0
  local delem = defender.element or 'neutral'
  local resist = defender.resist or {}
  local guarding = defender.guarding
  if guarding == nil then guarding = false end
  local power = skill.power or 0
  local sele = skill.element or 'physical'
  local hits = skill.hits or 1
  local td = skill.true_damage
  if td == nil then td = false end
  local seed = skill.seed or 0

  local COLS = {'fire','water','nature','neutral','ghost'}
  local MI = {
    physical = {100,100,100,100,0},
    fire     = {50,50,200,100,100},
    water    = {200,50,50,100,100},
    nature   = {50,200,50,100,100},
  }
  local ci = 4
  for i=1,5 do if COLS[i]==delem then ci=i end end
  local m = 100
  if not td then
    local row = MI[sele]
    if row then m = row[ci] else m = 100 end
  end

  local start_hp = hp
  local absorbed = 0
  local overkill = 0
  local crits = 0
  local resolved = 0
  local killed = false

  local diff = alevel - dlevel
  if diff < -10 then diff = -10 elseif diff > 10 then diff = 10 end

  for k=1,hits do
    if hp <= 0 then break end
    resolved = resolved + 1
    local p = power - 20*(k-1)
    if p < 10 then p = 10 end
    local d = math.floor(atk * p / 100)
    d = math.floor(d * (100 + 3*diff) / 100)

    local roll = (seed + 17*k) % 100
    local iscrit = roll < crit_chance
    if iscrit then
      d = math.floor(d * crit_mult / 100)
      crits = crits + 1
    end

    if not td then
      local pen = pen_pct
      if iscrit then pen = pen * 2 end
      if pen > 100 then pen = 100 end
      if pen < 0 then pen = 0 end
      local ea = math.floor(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pen_flat
      if ea < 0 then ea = 0 end
      d = math.floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))

      d = math.floor(d * m / 100)
      local r = resist[sele]
      if r == nil then r = 0 end
      if r < -50 then r = -50 elseif r > 80 then r = 80 end
      d = math.floor(d * (100 - r) / 100)
    end

    if guarding then d = math.floor(d / 2) end

    if d < 1 and not (not td and m == 0) then d = 1 end

    local a = shield
    if a > d then a = d end
    if a < 0 then a = 0 end
    shield = shield - a
    absorbed = absorbed + a
    local loss = d - a
    if a > 0 and shield == 0 then loss = math.floor(loss * 125 / 100) end

    if loss >= hp then
      overkill = loss - hp
      hp = 0
      killed = true
    else
      hp = hp - loss
    end
  end

  return {
    damage = start_hp - hp,
    absorbed = absorbed,
    hp = hp,
    shield = shield,
    overkill = overkill,
    crits = crits,
    hits = resolved,
    killed = killed,
  }
end

local a1 = {atk=40, level=12, crit_chance=30, crit_mult=150, pen_pct=25, pen_flat=5}
local d1 = {hp=60, shield=10, armor=40, level=10, element='nature', resist={fire=20}, guarding=false}
local s1 = {power=120, element='fire', hits=2, true_damage=false, seed=3}
local a2 = {atk=90, level=3, crit_chance=50, crit_mult=200, pen_pct=40, pen_flat=10}
local d2 = {hp=300, shield=25, armor=60, level=20, element='fire', resist={water=-30}, guarding=true}
local s2 = {power=100, element='water', hits=3, true_damage=false, seed=40}

local function fmt(t)
  return string.format("{damage=%s, absorbed=%s, hp=%s, shield=%s, overkill=%s, crits=%s, hits=%s, killed=%s}",
    tostring(t.damage), tostring(t.absorbed), tostring(t.hp), tostring(t.shield),
    tostring(t.overkill), tostring(t.crits), tostring(t.hits), tostring(t.killed))
end

local r1 = resolve(a1,d1,s1)
local r2 = resolve(a2,d2,s2)
apply_slot = resolve
SLOTFN = resolve
return "E1: "..fmt(r1).." | E2: "..fmt(r2)
"}

  if type(name) ~= 'string' then return 'none' end
  local ok, p = pcall(coreai_world_pos, name)
  if not ok or p == nil then return 'none' end
  local d = {}
  local best = nil

      local dz = t.z - p.z

      if best == nil or dist < best then best = dist end
    end
  end

  for k = 1, 8 do
    if d[k] ~= nil and d[k] <= 1.01 * best then return 'Tower' .. k end
  end
  return 'none'
end)

        local better = false

        elseif ks == kb then

    if v.alive and v.team == u.team then

      elseif v.hp < best.hp then best = v
      elseif v.hp == best.hp and v.id < best.id then best = v end
    end
  end

  local dmg = u.atk - t.def

  local a = t.shield
  if a > dmg then a = dmg end
  t.shield = t.shield - a

end

local function wpos(n)
  local ok, p = pcall(coreai_world_pos, n)
  if ok and type(p) == 'table' and type(p.x) == 'number' and type(p.z) == 'number' then return p end
  return nil
end

local function is_room_name(n)
  if type(n) ~= 'string' then return false end
  for i = 1, 9 do if n == 'Room_' .. LETTERS[i] then return true end end
  return false
end

local function room_names()
  local t = {}
  for i = 1, 9 do
    local n = 'Room_' .. LETTERS[i]
    if exists(n) then t[#t+1] = n end
  end
  return t
end

local function room_of(name)
  if not exists(name) then return 'none' end
  local p = wpos(name)
  if not p then return 'none' end
  local rs = room_names()
  if #rs == 0 then return 'none' end
  local d, best = {}, nil
  for i = 1, #rs do
    local rp = wpos(rs[i])
    if rp then
      local dx, dz = p.x - rp.x, p.z - rp.z
      local v = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz)
      d[rs[i]] = v
      if best == nil or v < best then best = v end
    end
  end
  if best == nil then return 'none' end
  for i = 1, #rs do
    local v = d[rs[i]]
    if v ~= nil and v <= 1.01 * best + 1e-9 then return rs[i] end
  end
  return 'none'

local function parse_door(name)
  if type(name) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  if name:sub(1, 5) ~= 'Door_' then return nil end
  local rest = name:sub(6)
  local p, q, col = rest:match('^([A-I])_([A-I])_(Red|Blue|Gold)$')
  if not p then
    p, q = rest:match('^([A-I])_([A-I])$')
    col = nil
  end
  if not p then return nil end
  if p == q then return nil end
  return p, q, col

local function parse_inv(inventory)

  local b = bitv[c]
